The inventory places a pale smudge at [3060,5140,140,100], which lies outside the 5120-pixel canvas height. The only pale smudge visible in the lower-right tile is at about [3060-3125,3826-3870]. That location is probably the intended mark. It is not text. The candidate mentions it without coordinates.

Further minor non-text marks were not listed in the inventory and do not form text. They are: faint small strokes near [1290-1310,770-825] and [780-895,815-855] in the upper area; a faint vertical stroke near [1090-1140,1000-1200]; faint vertical ticks and dots near [735-870,2910-3135].
